t: This is St Martin, Ludgate, an Anglican church on Ludgate Hill. There was a church here in medieval times, but the building you see dates from 1677 to 1684 and was designed by Sir Christopher Wren. After the Great Fire, he was given responsibility for rebuilding 52 City churches, and he also designed St Paul's Cathedral, just up the hill. People buried here include Sir Roger Cholmeley, a Lord Chief Justice who is best remembered for founding Highgate School. Anthony Hussey, a lawyer who compiled the official registers of several archbishops of Canterbury, is buried here too, as is the physician John Clarke.
